facts.function: particulate filter for a respirator/powered air system

gri_path: GRI 1: candidates are 5911.90 (textile articles for technical uses, filter media of textile), 9020.00 (breathing appliances; parts and accessories) and 8421.39 (gas filtering apparatus); Section XVI note 1(e) excludes textile technical articles from chapter 84

rejected_alternatives.reason: if the filter is textile, Sec. XVI note 1(e) sends it to 5911 (N253050)
face masks without replaceable filters; this is a replaceable filter

missing_facts: What is the filter material (textile nonwoven/fiber media, glass fiber, plastic or other) and is it a cartridge with a plastic housing?
Is the filter imported alone or with the respirator or helmet?
Does the filter have a rigid housing making it an accessory of a breathing appliance of 9020?
classification.rationale: The 6-digit result depends on the filter material and form: a textile filter is classified in 5911.90 (N253050, in force, 3M particulate filter for respirators), whereas a non-textile or housed filter may fall in 9020.00 or 8421.39. This is not stated, so I ask instead of guessing.
